linguistic_assessment: First sentence preserves the initial line-drag gesture followed by two further drags to establish the two bends. Dra, två gånger and två böjar convey the operation and count without omission.

Med Avsluta kurva identifies the actual Swedish Finish curve button verbatim. The unquoted UI label remains intelligible as a control name in this sentence; no wording revision is necessary for bounded semantic acceptance.
kan du slutföra kurvan describes optional completion of the current curve. Unlike fästa, it does not suggest fastening, attachment, image assembly, or a new external save operation.

innan båda böjarna har ställts in makes the early-completion boundary explicit. It permits finishing after zero or one bend, rather than requiring both. This is a faithful contextual explanation of commits it early, not an additional feature claim.
The full target is grammatical and sufficiently clear for this specific help action. This is model-based judgment, not a native-speaker or exhaustive idiomatic-style guarantee.

behavior_assessment.finding: PaintTool.CURVE binds ui_curve and this exact hint resource; hint obtains the localized resource through ui(hintId).
For CURVE, the apply button uses ui_finish_curve and calls paintCanvas.applyPending(). The tool_help button displays tool.hint; the cursor-help override does not apply to CURVE.
The initial drag establishes start/end. Later Curve gestures update control1 at internal stage 1 or control2 at stage 2.

After the initial line is released, the internal stage becomes 1 (zero bend gestures complete). After the next drag it becomes 2 (one bend gesture complete). After the second bend it becomes 3 and automatically calls applyPending().

applyPending commits the current Curve path only when curveStage > 0, then resets curveStage to 0. Thus the early-completion cases are internal stages 1 and 2, not 0 and 1. At stage 1 both control points are initialized on the line; at stage 2 the first has been repositioned. Repeated apply with no new pending curve does not recommit the Curve.
commitShape checkpoints document history, draws the path onto the document bitmap and marks it edited. This is a commit/finish operation, not attachment and not a file-save promise.

Existing regression source drives the real apply control after zero/one bends, asserts internal stage bends+1, pending state, committed ink, repeated activation and undo/redo. Reviewed as supporting test design only; not executed in this review.
